question: Can the exact ascending event-area before/after pair M1-SRC-002/005 become independently QA-ready over the approved source and upper-corridor AOIs using DEM coverage for its full processed extents, without treating QA as change evidence?

proposed_normative_amendments.reason: Their exact public catalog polygons jointly cover both approved event AOIs; M1-SRC-001/004 do not cover either event AOI. This subset is a new QA route, not a silent change to the frozen six-source route or an admitted baseline.

covers_without_intermediate_owner_reconf: bounded implementation, synthetic and installed ArcGIS disposable validation, reversible structural correction, public default-branch packet and implementation CI gates
final no-payload preflight and fixed-order seven exact public DEM payload acquisitions into new append-only non-Git attempt paths
per-tile byte identity, GeoTIFF structure, rights notice, and no-replace custody checks; stop on source drift or integrity failure
using the already approved exact PROJ25 grid offline, one fixed-order conversion for each newly verified tile and an append-only eleven-tile ellipsoidal DEM mosaic
read-only actual two-source footprint and DEM valid-pixel assessment before any radar geoprocessing, including explicit full processed-extent check
only on all prior gates passing, one fresh fixed-order two-source ArcGIS processing attempt with M1-SRC-002 then M1-SRC-005 and the reviewed REFINED_LEE QA route
only on both source outputs passing identity and persistence checks, frozen EPSG:32645 grid, AOI coverage, mask, and registration QA with no baseline admission
durable attempt, terminal, cleanup, and exact reconciliation receipts and sanitized public terminal publication

execution_gates: Confirm the seven exact STAC identities, HTTPS headers, license-document SHA, absence of redirect and payload collision, adequate disk and approved local ArcGIS runtime before request; stop if a material source or terms fact has drifted.
Reserve all per-tile terminal, error, and cleanup receipt identities before any payload request; use byte-zero requests only and never store credentials or payloads in Git.
Promote a tile only after complete expected-length download, SHA-256, GeoTIFF metadata and pixel-validity inspection, and no-replace custody check; keep partial and failed attempts quarantined.

Recheck exact existing PROJ25 grid and four approved DEM derivatives read-only, then convert the seven new tiles one time in fixed order; fail closed on vertical operation, sign, datum, seam, or output collision ambiguity.

Require the eleven-tile ellipsoidal mosaic to cover the actual processed extent of both exact SAR sources with valid elevation, not merely their catalog boxes or the approved AOIs; stop if this cannot be established.

Run the source-specific sequence with exact orbit correction, thermal-noise removal, beta-nought calibration, gamma-nought terrain flattening, REFINED_LEE Despeckle after RTF, and DEM-supplied GTC with GEOID NONE, preserving separate before and after lineage.
Do not begin M1-SRC-005 if M1-SRC-002 fails, and do not begin pair QA if either source or its required mask fails. No silent scene, DEM, geoid, CRS, polarization, resampling, or output substitution.

Apply frozen pixel-readiness thresholds: AOI coverage at least 0.99 and usable fraction at least 0.80 for pass_qa_only, with at least 30 stable control pairs, RMSE at most 0.5 pixel and absolute bias at most 0.5 pixel; retain defer/block/invalid outcomes without tuning.
Quarantine all derived rasters outside Git; publish only sanitized identities, QA metrics, disposition, limitations, and receipt hashes.

safe_recovery_within_envelope.before_real_payload_or_pixel_access: Correct reversible implementation and test defects, republish changed code, and rerun public CI without a new owner decision if exact inputs and scientific predicates remain unchanged.
safe_recovery_within_envelope.after_failed_dem_transport: Preserve the failed append-only attempt. A fresh byte-zero request for the same exact tile requires a separately recorded failure classification and fresh no-payload preflight; no automatic partial resume, no silent content or item substitution, and no second request after integrity or terms failure.
safe_recovery_within_envelope.after_failed_conversion_or_radar_process: Stop and preserve all attempts. No same-attempt retry, method change, new real radar process, or source substitution is released by this envelope.
